title: OpenAI Says Its Team Relies on AI Coding Agents For More Work Hours Everyday Than Human Researchers
description: OpenAI said its research teams now rely on AI coding agents for more work-hours than human researchers themselves. The company reported 3.1 agent-workdays for every human workday by mid-August. It said agent use has sharply increased, boosting code output and experiments, while noting that human oversight remains necessary for complex tasks.
